question: Why did sales drop in the South region last month?
description: Baseline South region revenue comparison between August 2023 and September 2023.
reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) AS OrderMonth, ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)), 2) AS Revenue FROM [Order Details] od JOIN Orders o ON od.OrderID = o.OrderID JOIN Customers c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID JOIN dim_country_region dcr ON c.Country = dcr.Country WHERE dcr.Region = 'South' AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) IN ('2023-08', '2023-09') GROUP BY OrderMonth ORDER BY OrderMonth;

question: Which product categories drove the most revenue in Q3 2023?
